items.source: JobFactory implementation that supports Runnable objects as well as standard Quartz Job instances.
items.translation: JobFactory 实现，支持 Runnable对象以及标准的 Quartz Job 实例。

items.source: Support classes for the open source scheduler Quartz, allowing to set up Quartz Schedulers, JobDetails and Triggers as beans in a Spring context.
items.translation: 支持开源调度器 Quartz 的类，允许在 Spring 上下文中将 Quartz Scheduler、JobDetails 和 Triggers 配置为 Bean。

items.source: Quartz Job implementation that invokes a specified method.
items.translation: 调用指定方法的 Quartz 作业实现。

items.source:
Simple implementation of the Quartz Job interface, applying the
passed-in JobDataMap and also the SchedulerContext as bean property
values.
items.translation: Quartz 作业接口的简单实现，将传入的 JobDataMap 和 SchedulerContext 作为 Bean 属性值应用。

items.source:
Callback interface to be implemented by Spring-managed
Quartz artifacts that need access to the SchedulerContext
(without having natural access to it).
items.translation: 需要访问 SchedulerContext（且无法自然访问该上下文）的由 Spring 管理的 Quartz 组件必须实现的回调接口。
